title: England set to be one of the first countries to eliminate hepatitis C
summary: England is on track to become one of the first countries globally to eliminate hepatitis C as a public health threat, with the UK's health service implementing widespread testing, direct-acting antiviral treatments, and targeted outreach programs to at-risk populations to achieve WHO elimination targets by 2030.
problem_solved: England is addressing the elimination of hepatitis C, a blood-borne virus that can cause liver disease and cancer if left untreated, affecting hundreds of thousands of people.
why_valuable: This represents a major public health achievement that could save countless lives and serve as a model for other countries working to eliminate blood-borne diseases.
